prompt_text: Use reference 1 ONLY as geometry guide for a single broad, flat, full-height rectangular LEFT elevation. References 2 and 3 are the two target Larracos corner sources and control material, palette, details, and object identity. Create an atlas with exactly two separate cells vertically: outer corner first, inner corner second. In each cell show one level full-height pale stone wall face with dark outlines, teal stripe, source-style stone blocks, and clean groundline. These are straight principal elevations: no L plan, no overhead view, no angled two-face perspective, no decorative extra architecture. Keep the source-supported gold square cap at the appropriate end(s) and preserve coral plant only on inner corner near its join if visible. Other joined arm is occluded by the camera. Transparent background, no text, no shadows, no guide marks.
